notes: [MVP]

text: That's one step of the certification done. One more and I'll sign it off.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's the Gale Queen. Everyone goes. Listen to the scene board and do your one job well.
notes: [MVP]

text: Every last one of them. I'm proud of this station tonight.
notes: [MVP]

text: Tobias needs a lift out to the Harbor Light. Be gentle, he gets seasick.
notes: [MVP]

text: Look at that. First light on the isles in years. That's your doing.
notes: [MVP]

text: That one needs lifting. Ask for the helicopter. Don't be a hero.
You don't call a helicopter for a cold swimmer who's chatting. Next time, the slipway.
notes: [MVP]

text: Cocoa's hot if anyone wants it.
notes: [MVP]

text: Quiet out there. I don't trust quiet.
notes: [MVP]

text: Tobias says the Harbor Light lamp is sulking again. He talks to it, you know.
notes: [MVP]

text: Mind Bosun near the slipway. He shakes.
notes: [MVP]

text: Ten minutes in the water and no lifejacket? Take the casualty bag.
notes: [MVP]

text: New rank, new responsibilities. Same kettle.
notes: [MVP]

text: Not answering? Take the RIB. You'll want two of you for that lift.
notes: [MVP]

text: There's the sun. Come in, get dry, tell me how it went.
notes: [MVP]

text: Storm's coming, Recruit. The harbour mouth will get lively. Take the RIB if you've got it.
notes: [MVP]

text: Weather's turning. Batten down, then go out. In that order.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's the storm. The bay will hold. The harbour mouth won't.
notes: [MVP]

text: Forget the bridle and you'll know about it at the first snatch.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's Vance Sterling taking photos again. Smile, Recruit, then get on with it.
notes: [MVP]

text: You came in hot. Slower on the last bit and they don't get a faceful of wash.
notes: [MVP]

text: You came in from upwind and the boat drifted onto them. Downwind, always.
notes: [MVP]

text: Your handover was muddled. Age, time, mechanism, injuries, signs, treatment. In that order.
notes: [MVP]

text: They're safe, and that's what counts. Now let's make it cleaner.
notes: [MVP]

text: Your ETA was well out. Look at the chart before you answer.
notes: [MVP]

text: Gold. Textbook. Don't let it go to your head.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's how it's done. Kettle's on.
notes: [MVP]

text: No rubbing their arms. It doesn't warm them, it hurts them.
notes: [MVP]

text: Slack line near your stern. That's how propellers get eaten.
notes: [MVP]

text: You lost sight of them. Once you see them, you don't look away.
notes: [MVP]

text: No drinks for a drowsy casualty. Only when they're fully alert.
notes: [MVP]

text: Answer the Coastguard quickly. They can't see you, they can only hear you.
notes: [MVP]

text: Good work. One step to tidy up, and that's gold.
notes: [MVP]

text: Too many slams on the way home. Quarter the waves and ease off on the crests.
notes: [MVP]

text: You skipped the survey. That's how you miss the thing that matters.
notes: [MVP]

text: Haven Patrol had to take it. No shame in that. Next time, we do it ourselves.
notes: [MVP]

text: The line was red too often. Ease off when the tow surfs towards you.
notes: [MVP]

text: Wrong lift for a cold casualty. Keep them flat.
notes: [MVP]

text: You've found everything in the bay worth finding. Show off.
notes: [MVP]

text: An Admiralty anchor. That's older than the station. Older than me, nearly.
notes: [MVP]

text: A message in a bottle? Read it on the way back. If it's a mayday, I'll want to know.
notes: [MVP]

text: An old mooring buoy, adrift. Report it, someone could hit that at night.
notes: [MVP]

text: A sea cave. Lovely to look at, a trap on a rising tide. Remember where it is.
Now that's a find. Mark it on the chart and I'll tell Tobias.
notes: [MVP]

text: Good eyes, Recruit. That goes in the station log.
notes: [MVP]

text: Harbor Light. Tobias kept it for thirty years. Ask him about the night the lamp went out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Haven Head. Best view on the island. You can see weather coming an hour out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Old Ned's kelp gully. He swore the best lobsters live down there. He was right.
notes: [MVP]

text: A piece of the Skerry lens. Bring it home carefully, Tobias will cry.
That's one of Tobias's lights. Dark for years. Not for much longer.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's the Morwenna. Went down in the Long Storm. Everyone got off her, thank goodness.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's the outpost. Free delivery dock, and somebody keeps the kettle warm.
That rock's not on the chart. It is now. Well spotted.
notes: [MVP]

text: The rock pools under Haven Head. Look, don't take. The crabs live there.
notes: [MVP]

text: The sandbar moves with every storm. Barnaby finds it with his keel. You found it with your eyes.
notes: [MVP]

text: Grey seals hauled out. Give them room, they bite harder than Bosun.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's an old wreck. Plenty of those since the Long Storm. Keep clear of her at low water.
notes: [MVP]

text: Throw beyond it and upwind. Let the line drift down onto it.
notes: [MVP]

text: Come in from downwind. Slow right down. Neutral before you reach them.
notes: [MVP]

text: Blanket on. Out of the wind is half the battle.
notes: [MVP]

text: And this great lump is Bosun. He's decided he's yours.
notes: [MVP]

text: He'll find them before you do. Let him.
notes: [MVP]
[MVP]

text: Hold to wind up, let go to throw.
notes: [MVP]

text: Lovely. That's the drill. Now we wait for the kettle.
notes: [MVP]

text: Quick drill before the paint dries, Recruit.
notes: [MVP]

text: Eyes on them. Don't look away, not for a second.
notes: [MVP]

text: Your first rescue. Not bad for a Tuesday.
notes: [MVP]

text: Ambulance is at the slipway. Tell them what you found and what you did.
notes: [MVP]

text: Now haul. Hand over hand. Steady, not fast.
notes: [MVP]

text: Easy. Too fast and you'll pull their face under.
notes: [MVP]

text: See the fellow on the beach waving? He's pointing right at them.
notes: [MVP]

text: Throw bag and thermal blanket, already aboard. The jet ski's yours. Go.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's a training manikin. It won't mind if you miss. The wind will, though.
notes: [MVP]

text: Three rescues. You're one of us now, Recruit.
notes: [MVP]

text: Barnaby's stuck again. Take the loaner RIB. The crew know the tow; you learn it.
notes: [MVP]

text: Tired swimmer, well out. You'll go in the water this time, as a trainee. Float first, always.
notes: [MVP]

text: That's a real one. Answer them, Recruit. Tell them you're going.
notes: [MVP]

text: Easy on the way back. Every bump hurts when you're cold.
notes: [MVP]

text: Onto the sled, lying flat. Good.
notes: [MVP]

text: Ask them something. Are they breathing easy? Are they shivering?
notes: [MVP]

text: Same as the drill. Beyond them, upwind.
notes: [MVP]
[MVP]

text: Anchor's down! Holding, I think. Holding.
notes: [MVP]

text: Coastguard, the Optimist, just out for mackerel. Not stuck. Yet. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Lovely morning for it, Coastguard. Engine's purring. Touch wood. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Leaving her? Right. Right you are. Coming across.
notes: [MVP]

text: Lifejackets on, yes. Always. The Chief would have my hide.
notes: [MVP]

text: Made fast on the samson post. Like the Chief taught me.
notes: [MVP]
[MVP]

text: Gale Isles Coastguard, the Optimist. Just a little stuck again! On the sandbar, tide's coming in. One aboard. Over.
notes: [MVP]

text: Coastguard, the Optimist. I, er, nodded off. I'm not entirely sure where I am. I can see a lighthouse. Over.
notes: [MVP]

text: Pan-pan, pan-pan, pan-pan. All stations, this is the Optimist, the Optimist. Engine's packed up just past the harbour mouth. Two of us aboard, both fine, both wearing lifejackets. Drifting a bit. Over.

notes: [MVP]

text: Coastguard, the Optimist, radio check, over.
notes: [MVP]

text: Rocks are getting awfully close, Coastguard! Over!
notes: [MVP]
[MVP]

text: Thank you, thank you. Pints are on me. Well, cocoa.
notes: [MVP]

text: Just a little stuck again, Chief! Not anymore, though.
notes: [MVP]

text: I'll get that engine looked at. Properly this time.
notes: [MVP]

text: She's drifting towards the harbour wall now, Coastguard. Getting closer. Over.
notes: [MVP]

text: Okay. I'll follow you. Don't let go.

notes: [MVP]

notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, lifeguard flags are up on Haven Sands. Please swim between the red and yellow flags. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Coastguard copies your hazard report. Navigational warning to follow. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Hazel, Coastguard, roger. We'll ask a unit to take a look. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Hazel, this channel is for working traffic, but thank you. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Roger, Hazel. One cat on one buoy. Tasking the nearest unit. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, Gale Isles Coastguard. Inshore forecast follows. Wind south-west, three to four. Sea slight. Fair. Visibility good. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Skerries Dive Shop, Coastguard, roger, six kayaks out to the sea caves, back by four. Out.
All stations, Skerry Light is lit and showing again. Out.
Coastguard copies. Logged on the chart. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Northern Dawn, Coastguard, roger, fishing at Gannet Rock. Out.
Optimist, Coastguard. Barnaby, is that you on channel sixteen again? Over.
notes: [MVP]

text: Optimist, Coastguard. Glad to hear it. Mind the sandbar. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: Haven Patrol, Coastguard, loud and clear. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, Gale Isles Coastguard. Day watch has the net. Good morning. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, Gale Isles Coastguard. Night watch has the net. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, the station siren will be tested at noon. This is a test only. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, high water at Port Haven this afternoon. Expect the sandbar to cover quickly. Out.
notes: [MVP]

text: All stations, Harbor Light is lit and showing. Mariners take note. Out.
